title: Stage DMA register directories (partial)
changes: Stage a dedicated authenticated resource and bus overlay for two EUR DMA register address directories while preserving guest indexing and hardware operations; acceptance is suspended pending the remaining Wine checks.
validation: Source e189-dma-source-_zu8l44g and Wine trace e189-dma-trace-wine-vgsu5kue pass. Wine e189-dma-wine-598qsw1v passes publication, 16 interpreter/native readers, four controlled DMA writes, mixed boundaries and full-state/guest-clock equality.
The first Wine attempt e189-dma-wine-gsiv7n3d failed because its test executed a chained native store twice; a focused Sol consultation identified the issue and the corrected retry passed.
limitations: Paused at user request: the altered-source scene and production CLI remain unverified. Other DMA callers, the IWRAM helper vector, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurements were performed.
